## Added

- **Verification before the execution stops.** While omp is executing an approved change, the session that approved it can't stop with a checked task that has no `_Verified:` note — it gets sent back (at most twice per change) to verify and annotate. Subagents working on the change are never blocked.
- **Review policy when execution finishes.** Once the handed-off execution settles, `readyset.review.mode` is applied: either a skip stub in `REVIEW.md` saying why nothing needed review, or a notice to run `/readyset --review <change-id>` naming what triggered it.
- **Survives an omp restart.** An unsettled execution is saved to `readyset/changes/<id>/handoff.json`. Restart or resume omp and the same session picks it back up; `/readyset --review <id>` closes one another session left behind.
- **Commits made during execution count.** The commit you approved on is recorded, so scope checks, review triggers and diff stats see work the execution already committed.

## Changed

- **Execution runs on the model you pinned** (`--phase-model apply=…`, else `--model`), and your previous model comes back once the execution settles.
- **Pauses aren't endings.** If execution stops to ask you something, the execution model stays active. Two pauses with no progress in between settle it as stalled; running `/readyset` again supersedes it cleanly.
- **Grilling runs on the grill model** (`--phase-model grill=…` / `readyset.model.phases.grill`, else your run pin) and switches back once the brainstorm is written. If `readyset.model` or `modelRoles.default` is configured, grilling now uses it.
- Leaner, lane-aware prompts; the fast lane's review only reads what the fast lane writes.
- The README benchmark table is withdrawn until a clean rerun on this version.

## Fixed

- The grill → propose hand-over no longer crashes.
- `- _Verified: …` written as a sub-bullet counts as a verification note.
- The phase log no longer records a grill model that wasn't used, or an unbalanced archive event.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0
